data.title: 阿尔法 · 月夜露台的独处汇报
data.description: 幽暗庭园顶层露台上圆月当空，夜风轻拂金色发丝。阿尔法双手轻捧羊皮纸卷轴，身着紧致黑色史莱姆战服侧立在暗影身旁，清澈蓝眸迎向对方的目光，语气柔和从容。
data.location: grand marble balcony under a luminous full moon in starry night
data.action: standing gracefully beside Shadow holding an ancient parchment scroll, looking back with fond crystal blue eyes and a soft warm smile
data.lighting: moonlight with a lantern on the balcony railing softly illuminating her face
data.mood: calm tactical romance, absolute loyalty, quiet midnight companionship
data.promptProse: Standing on a marble balcony under the full moon, blonde elf Alpha in her sleek black slime bodysuit turns back with gentle blue eyes and a quiet smile. A lantern on the railing casts a soft glow over her face and scroll.
data.animaCaption: A lantern on the railing softly lights Alpha's face and scroll while the moon shines behind her.
